reponse: Run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload — the front reads flags from /api/flags, so FEATURE_FLAGS in .env.local is ignored since #447 [2][3]. You can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. Note the old instructions (FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local) [1] are now outdated, which explains why some setups stopped showing the dashboards [3]. If tiles stay empty in new workspaces, it may be the blank-state issue for workspaces with no events [5].
